## Andrew John Dickinson

I am an economist with expertise in causal inference, machine learning, and applied econometrics.

I received my PhD in Economics from the University of Oregon in September 2025, where I studied applied microeconometrics with a focus on environmental and labor economics. Prior to graduate school, I worked in crime economics research, and studied Economics at San Diego State University.

Currently on the job market 2025-2026.
